story.label: Our story
story.title: Adornment is an *old language.*
paragraphs: A grandmother's bangles. A bride's rani haar. Jhumkas borrowed for Eid and never quite returned. In South Asian homes, jewelry carries memory as much as it carries light.
Sharif Adornment brings that tradition to Queens — jewelry and accessories chosen piece by piece for weddings, festivals and every celebration in between, and delivered to your door.

faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Good to *know.*
faq.intro: Can't find what you're looking for? Message us — we're happy to help.

items.a: Tap “Ask about this piece” on anything you like, message us on Messenger, or call or text. We'll confirm availability, price and delivery with you directly.
Yes. Delivery and contactless delivery are available. Ask us about timing for your area and your event date.

items.q: Can I see pieces before I order?
items.a: Yes — message us on Messenger and we'll send more photos and videos of any piece.

items.q: Why does it say “Price on request”?
items.a: Many pieces are sets or one-of-a-kind. Message us and we'll share the price straight away.
Some pieces can be rented for an event — they're marked “For rent”. Ask us about dates and terms.

items.q: Can I return or exchange a piece?
items.a: Please ask us before you order and we'll explain the options for your piece.

items.q: How should I care for my jewelry?
items.a: Keep it dry and away from perfume, lotion and hairspray. Put it on last and take it off first. Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth after wearing, and store each piece separately in a pouch or box so stones and pearls don't scratch.

items.q: Can you help me style a look?
items.a: Of course. Send us a photo of your outfit and the occasion, and we'll suggest a set, bangles and a potli to complete it.
